evidence_quotes.agenda: Never asked -- this is a re-quote/rebooking call on an already-booked move; rep went straight into pulling up the account and handling the price question.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer wanted a lower price since item count dropped; rep explained the two-and-a-half-hour minimum once and didn't probe further on what else might change her mind.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: that also includes like all the taxes, the fuel, the travel...it's all inclusive, like there's no surprises at the end

top_strength: Genuinely warm rapport (shared laugh about Texas summers) while patiently re-explaining why the minimum rate doesn't drop just because box count did.
coaching_note: Judgment call: graded as a full_sales_call rather than N/A-ing the discovery items, since this is a re-quote conversation, not a fresh discovery call -- but the agenda question and both Sheet 1-4 differentiators besides damage coverage were still skippable opportunities the rep didn't take.
